name: crack-bot
description: crack-bot: fast live-DOM computer use for Grok Bot. Decides with TypeSafe Jev through Vercel AI Gateway and clicks the observed node; no screenshot loop.

interface.shortDescription: Fast live-DOM web tasks instead of slow screenshot computer use.
interface.longDescription: crack-bot runs the jev-ultrafast loop on the Bot computer: snapshot live DOM nodes, ask TypeSafe Jev on Vercel AI Gateway (typesafe-ai/jev) what to do, click that node. Call fast_web_task instead of screenshot computer use. On TYPE_TEXT, write the string and call fast_web_fill. Attaches to this agent's Chrome when remote debugging is enabled. Requires AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY.
defaultPrompt: Use fast_web_task for web work. Do not screenshot-click.
If status is need_text, write the field value from the goal and call fast_web_fill.
Open example.com with fast_web_task and stop when the heading is visible.
